flash: Check which OS Type is installed on your Switch (dvs-os-onl / dvs-os-sonic): run "cat /etc/nvidia-release"

Boot your Switch 4xxx series into ONIE For dvs-os-onl, run 'onl-onie-boot-mode uninstall && reboot'. For dvs-os-sonic: running 'onie-boot-uninstall-os'. Switch will: Boot to ONIE Uninstall Mode -> Uninstall existing OS -> Auto-Reboot to ONIE Install Mode. Please allow up to 15 minutes for procedure to complete.
Make sure Switch 4xxx series and your Host system are connected to the same management network.
Enter the IP address, username and password of your Switch 4xxx series.
